<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire

A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.

### Controls

- **F** or **Enter** — strike
- **Q** — Arcane Burst (costs 12 mana)
- **Space** — evade a guardian's telegraphed attack
- **R** — drink a healing potion
- The on-screen buttons also work with touch and mouse.

Defeat each floor guardian to ascend. Every tenth floor is a boss; every fifth floor can award a stronger sword. Earn XP to level up and receive stat points, then tap **+ Stat Points** to invest. Reach and defeat the guardian on Floor 100 to win.

+

Built **ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire**, a complete browser RPG in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.

- Fight guardians across **100 floors**, with a boss every tenth floor and a victory sequence at the summit.
- Use strikes, mana-based Arcane Burst, timed evades, and healing potions.
- Earn XP and gold, level up, invest stat points, find stronger weapons, and automatically save progress.
- Play with keyboard or touch-friendly on-screen controls; the layout adapts to mobile.
- See `README.md` for controls and gameplay notes.

I treated “super realistic” as a cinematic, atmospheric original canvas-rendered arena so the game stays self-contained. Verified the page renders and a strike successfully damages the guardian, with no browser runtime errors.
